Status truth for the project. Update this file and the matching
`docs/plans/*.md.tasks.json` together whenever a task changes state.

## Decisions log

- **2026-09-17 — Architecture is user-owned.** The feature-first tree in the
  setup plan is discarded. The user designs and builds the structure; Claude
  reads it and works within it. Naming/privacy rules, product decisions and the
  tutor working mode stay.
- **2026-09-17 — BaaS is Firebase; AI also via Firebase** (Cloud Functions
  proxy or Firebase AI Logic, chosen at milestone 5).
- **2026-09-17 — Android only, for now.** `ios/`, `linux/`, `macos/`,
  `windows/`, `web/` deleted; regenerate with
  `flutter create . --platforms=<name>` when a platform is wanted.

## Next session starts here

Phase 0 is complete and committed. Nothing is in flight. Open items, in order:
